Guideline: Use bevy_ui with yolo-layout Taffy integration
Description: Bevy ECS UI uses Taffy flexbox/grid layout and maps cleanly to crates/yolo-layout and catalog/conversion.toml
Do: Configure Node layout components with Val::Px on the 4dp/8dp grid and semantic M3Theme resources
Don't: Hardcode screen-space pixel coordinates that break on window resize
Code Good: commands.spawn((Node { padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(16.0)), row_gap: Val::Px(8.0), ..default() }, BackgroundColor(theme.surface)));

Guideline: Drive Bevy UI colors from a shared M3Theme Resource
Description: catalog/conversion.toml maps M3 roles (primary, on_primary, surface, primary_container) to a Bevy Resource
Do: Insert an M3Theme Resource derived from YoloThemePreset and update BackgroundColor/BorderColor in an observer or system
Don't: Scatter Color::srgb literals across dozens of ECS spawn systems
Code Good: fn apply_theme(theme: Res<M3Theme>, mut q: Query<&mut BackgroundColor, With<PrimaryButton>>) { ... }

Guideline: Handle Interaction states with M3 state layers
Description: Bevy UI updates Interaction (Pressed, Hovered, None) on interactive entities; state layers blend content color at hover/press alpha
Do: Query (&Interaction, &mut BackgroundColor) with Changed<Interaction> and apply state-layer tokens
Don't: Poll every button every frame without Changed<Interaction> filtering
Code Bad: Query<(&Interaction, &mut BackgroundColor), With<Button>> // runs on unchanged entities every frame

Guideline: Use headless bevy_ui_widgets with Yolo UI skins
Description: catalog/conversion.toml binds bevy_ui_widgets::Button, Checkbox, RadioButton and Slider to M3 and YoloThemePreset skins
Do: Compose interactive controls from bevy_ui_widgets and Observers (On<Pointer<Click>>)
Don't: Roll custom mouse hit-testing with raw window cursor coordinates

Guideline: Attach bevy_a11y AccessibilityNode to custom controls
Description: bevy_a11y bridges Bevy ECS UI entities to OS screen readers via AccessKit
Do: Attach AccessibilityNode with Role and label on icon buttons, sliders and dialogs
Don't: Spawn icon-only ImageNode buttons with no accessible name

Guideline: Use bevy-inspector-egui for live ECS & UI inspection
Description: Integrate bevy-inspector-egui with WorldInspectorPlugin to inspect Node computed layout, transforms and resources in real time
Do: Add WorldInspectorPlugin gated behind a dev/inspector cargo feature and launch via bun ui devtools bevy
Don't: Print Node sizes to stdout every frame with info!()

Description: Bevy Text + TextFont + TextColor components control typography; map M3 display/headline/title/body/label scales consistently
Do: Resolve TextFont { font, font_size } from the active YoloStyle typescale
Don't: Pick arbitrary font_size floats (13.7, 19.3) per system

Guideline: Respect reduced motion in Bevy tween systems
Description: UI transitions (bottom sheets, drawers, toasts) should use spring/easing curves and snap when reduced-motion is active
Do: Check the accessibility reduced-motion resource before scheduling UI transform tweens
Don't: Run continuous decorative UI animations that cannot be paused

Guideline: Separate HUD/UI camera from 3D world camera
Description: Render UI on a dedicated Camera2d or explicit TargetCamera with clear order priority
Do: Tag the UI root node with TargetCamera and configure Camera.order deterministically
Don't: Rely on ambiguous default camera ordering when multiple 3D viewports exist
Code Bad: commands.spawn(Node::default()); // ambiguous when Viewer3D spawns extra cameras

Guideline: Batch UI atlas textures and avoid per-frame Node respawns
Description: Spawning and despawning entire UI trees every frame fragments ECS archetypes and triggers full Taffy relayouts
Do: Mutate Text, Visibility or BackgroundColor in-place and use texture atlases for icons
Don't: despawn_recursive() and respawn the HUD every Update tick
